messages:
Maya K: hey team, quick onboarding snag — I accepted the Redwood org invite but can't see any private repos (e.g. infra-config). GitHub shows the invite as accepted but trying to access private repos gives a permissions error. :confused:
Alex P: hey Maya — can you share the github username that you accepted the invite with? sometimes invites go to a different account if you have multiple.
Maya K: username is maya-k (personal), but I also have maya.k-work linked to my work email. The invite came to my work email though. I tried switching accounts but it kept redirecting me to the personal one.
Sam R: if the invite went to your work email you'll need to accept it while logged into the work github account. We can also reissue the invite to the exact username if easier. Do you have 2FA enabled on the account you want to use?
Maya K: 2FA is on (auth app). Also when I try `ssh -T git@github.com` I get "Permission denied (publickey)" — so no SSH access yet.
Alex P: ok, i'll reissue the invite to maya-k-work now and add a note to enable SSO. give it a minute then re-check. cc @it-bot to watch for any SSO blocks.
it-bot: FYI — reissued org invite to github username: maya-k-work. Invite email sent to maya.k@redwood.com.
Maya K: got the new invite email, accepted it, but GitHub shows a banner saying "You must enable SSO for Redwood to access organization resources". Is that expected?
Jen L: yes — for private repos we require SSO/SAML authorization. Click the blue "Authorize" button in the banner, then sign in with your company SSO. After that your org membership and team access should resolve.
Maya K: clicked authorize, completed SSO flow, and now I can see infra-config and a few other private repos. SSH still failed though until I added my public key to the work account. After adding key `ssh -T` returns "Hi maya-k-work! You've successfully authenticated..." — all good now. :tada:
Alex P: awesome. i also added you to team eng-core which grants write to infra-config and read to infra-ops. we'll add eng-oncall tomorrow.
Sam R: if anything else pops up ping #eng or @people-ops. welcome aboard! :wave:
people-ops: noted — onboarding checklist updated for Maya K: github access ✅, teams=eng-core ✅, repos=infra-config, platform-sdks, internal-deps.
onboard-bot: Welcome Maya K! Your GitHub access was confirmed and checklist advanced. Enjoy your first week 🎉
